name: pre-read-grant-handover-denies-without-a-write-claim
description: R8, and the cross-runtime form of Cohexa-ai/agent-coherence#196: A pre-reads (SHARED on v1), B pre-edits (acquires EXCLUSIVE, invalidating A) but never commits. Nothing was written and the version never moved, so A's next pre-read on the strict-tracked artifact denies with the GRANT-CHANGE reason, not the write one. The issue reported the old bytes verbatim: "CLAUDE.md was updated by session <unknown> at <t>" — a write that never happened, named against a writer that does not exist, at a timestamp when nothing was written. The summary is asserted too rather than ignored, because the prose alone would pass with a version the response got wrong: current_version must still be 1 and prior_version_seen_by_session must be the 1 that A actually observed, not the 0 the old current-minus-one inference reported. Both backends derive both halves the same way.

hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason: Stale read denied: your grant on CLAUDE.md was revoked and no new version was committed — CLAUDE.md is still at v1. Re-read CLAUDE.md via the Read tool before proceeding. This denial is structural (v0.2 strict mode); retrying the same operation will produce the same denial.
